paths.title: Newcomer: Java and robot basics
paths.description: Build programming vocabulary, practice small Java programs, and follow information and power through a robot.
outcomes: Explain variables, branching, loops, methods, and classes
Compile and check small Java programs
Trace a robot command from operator input to mechanism

paths.title: Robot programmer: commands and mechanisms
paths.description: Connect command-based architecture, a simulated intake, scheduler behavior, and a real Team 1257 code trace.
outcomes: Explain subsystem requirements and interruption
Build or trace a command-based intake in simulation
Distinguish robot code from evidence of deployed behavior

paths.title: Controls, localization, and autonomous
paths.description: Connect sensors and feedback to motion, drivetrain coordinates, paths, and recorded data.
outcomes: Interpret encoder units, control error, and motion constraints
Predict swerve motion and explain odometry uncertainty
Trace a real autonomous selection and investigate a real log without overstating it

paths.title: Vision: pixels, pose and alignment
paths.description: Connect image formation, calibration, coordinate transforms and timestamped pose estimates to a controlled robot approach.
outcomes: Distinguish a target detection from a field-relative robot pose
Explain calibration, camera transforms and capture timestamps with worked examples
Design measurement acceptance and target-loss behavior before tuning alignment

paths.title: Software architecture: IO, replay, and calibration
paths.description: Separate hardware from behavior, build repeatable simulation, and validate calibration and sensor data.
outcomes: Inject real, simulated and replay inputs without rewriting mechanism behavior
Build a bounded interpolation table and explain its measurement limits
Test timing, state and invalid sensor handling

paths.title: Programming by robot type
paths.description: Translate a robot role and mechanism layout into sensors, control goals, command ownership and failure handling.
outcomes: Compare chassis aiming with turret aiming and elevators with telescoping arms
Map all fifteen research concepts to explicit software contracts
Specify simulation and failure tests for a chosen architecture

paths.title: Team integration: build, investigate, and communicate
paths.description: Bring electrical, mechanical, programming, strategy, and safety perspectives into a shared review.
outcomes: Map power, signals, and mechanism interfaces
Develop a safe troubleshooting and test plan
Report observations, uncertainty, and decisions across subteams
